name: Grey Plague
source:
Year 2020.

A mysterious disease has broken out. The disease is suspected to be a mutation of tuberculosis, which had been eliminated years ago. 

With the power to see peoples' internal organs, can you save everyone from Grey Plague?

[From [url=https://zephyo.itch.io/grey-plague]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2020年。

一种神秘的疾病爆发了。这种疾病被怀疑是结核病的变异，而结核病在多年前就已被消灭。

拥有能看到人的内脏的能力，你能将所有人从灰瘟疫中拯救出来吗？

[来自[url=https://zephyo.itch.io/grey-plague]itch.io[/url]]
